14.06.2024 Heard Mr R Chetri, learned counsel for the petitioner, Sri Niraj Patel @ Niraj Kr. Patel,
who has filed this application under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, with prayer for pre-arrest bail, as he is apprehending arrest in connection with Fatashil Ambari PS Case No. 218/20223, under Sections 476/376/511 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 3.
The FIR unfolds that the petitioner attempted to commit rape on the victim on Page No.# 2/2 17.09.2023, at about 03:30 am by sneaking into the bedroom of the victim.
4. Heard Mr R R Kaushik, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State of Assam.
5. I have considered the submissions at the Bar with circumspection.
6. I have also perused the Case Diary.

sentences.text: It appears that interim pre-arrest bail granted to the petitioner by a coordinate Bench of this Court can be made absolute.
8. Investigation has progressed to a considerable extent.
The petitioner has appeared before the IO and his statement has already been recorded.
9. It appears that custodial interrogation of the petitioner may not be required.
10. In view of my foregoing discussions, the interim pre-arrest bail order dated 24.04.2024, is hereby made absolute.
11. Anticipatory Bail Application stands disposed of.
